title: Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
venue: Humanoids 2026; acceptance reported by arXiv and author institution

release_status.value: Related DAPS ICLR 2026 code verified; README lists LAFAN as TODO release. Full three-stage humanoid pipeline and deployment checkpoints not verified as publicly released.

evidence_boundaries: DAPS is adopted from earlier work, not invented in this paper
Inputs are already G1-retargeted motions, not raw human video
Stage-1 matched-capacity comparison is not a downstream tracking ablation
Three PPO policies use distinct finite generated-motion banks
Hardware consumes offline precomputed tokens; no online TrajectoryGPT or DAPS decoder in 50 Hz loop
Wildcard removes reference tracking during interval but regularization remains
No held-out latent-schedule generalization or multi-trial hardware success statistics reported
Raw qpos MSE mixes configuration components and is not Cartesian MPJPE in meters
Text conditioning supported in formulation; hardware bank uses LAFAN1 label-conditioned generator
Actor action parameterization is not fully specified in reviewed paper
